feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Trump's big weekend: The arch, Greenland, and media outlets banned from White House
entry.summary: President Trump's exertion of power over the press, Greenland and even the D.C. landscape are teeing up questions over the president's limits.

entry.title: Many GOP candidates still echo Trump's 2020 claims. Lots of voters want to move on
entry.summary: While many Republican candidates, even in some critical tossup races, still back President Trump's baseless claims about election integrity, some GOP voters say they are ready to move on.

entry.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump after being barred from White House
entry.summary: Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico say they were prevented from entering the White House grounds after President Trump announced plans to ban all three outlets.

entry.title: President Trump navigates tough political waters with UNGA, Xi visit and AI
entry.summary: President Trump has a big week on the international stage, from the United Nations General Assembly to hosting the Chinese president at the White House.

entry.title: Trump says his D.C. arch will serve as 'military complex' with snipers and drones
entry.summary: President Trump has claimed that military operations are needed at his proposed triumphal arch in Washington D.C., in order to protect national security. A federal court is weighing the arch's legality.

entry.title: In Colorado, a GOP candidate says his differences with Trump show he's with the voters
entry.summary: We look at Republican Congressman Jeff Hurd's campaign in Colorado, where he is using his breaks with President Trump as an asset in his bid for reelection.

entry.title: Politics chat: Trump announces a Greenland deal, bans more media from the White House
entry.summary: We look at President Trump's announced ban of some media outlets covering the White House, as well as what a big cash windfall might mean for Republicans in the coming midterm elections.

entry.title: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds launched at Moscow
entry.summary: Moscow's mayor described the wave of drones as the "largest ever" attack on the Russian capital and said there had been damage to a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building.

entry.title: SpaceX has big plans for a new Louisiana 'Star Base,' worrying some near there
entry.summary: State officials say the new SpaceX site will be a $100 billion investment and launch thousands of rockets. Lawmakers helped ease regulations and negotiations were covered under nondisclosure agreements.

entry.title: The high stakes drama a reporter has seen covering the UN General Assembly
entry.summary: Over the years NPR's Michele Kelemen has seen high stakes diplomacy play out at the UN General Assembly.
